distribution.narrative: Liao et al. (2022) provides the first mainland-China records from Fujian, Sichuan and Yunnan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently documents the prior Taiwan occurrence; no new province is inferred from the earlier source.

host_note: Host remains unknown in the currently integrated evidence; no host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus calvus Beaver & Liu, 2007.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus calvus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone and Liao et al. (2022): Scolytoplatypus calvus Beaver & Liu, 2007, VSN_5400. Beaver & Liu (2010) is retained as earlier Taiwan evidence.
